title: Explicit restricted fixed-coefficient single-complex data
statement: For schemes W,S, k:W→S, a fixed abelian sheaf F on W and an etale object U over S, construct the pullback diagram and cone for a diagram in Over W, the degree-zero single complex on each double inverse image of F, its canonical triangle isomorphism from the three inverse-image composition comparisons, and the constant apex complex with the inverse leg isomorphisms. All six constructions are explicit and contain no postponed data.

proof.text: Use the explicit pullback construction and its projection identities to define the diagram and cone. Form the single complexes of iterated inverse images. Compose the inverse-image comparison isomorphisms and the natural single comparison; the map is invertible since it is a composite of isomorphisms. Define the constant apex diagram and take inverse leg isomorphisms.
